decisions.reason: It still fits the firm’s core shop-customization business, but as a relatively narrow plugin that was no longer visibly promoted, it faces moderate rationalization risk if demand is too small or the function has become standard.

The ERP interface plugin supports the firm’s strategic move toward deeper multichannel integration and sticky client relationships, so management would usually retain it unless maintenance effort clearly outweighs project value.

After already removing two similar price-comparison tracking plugins and with this category being less central than broader commerce integration, management would likely consolidate further and release resources for stronger growth areas.

The net price reporting plugin matches the firm’s analytics and measurable-optimization positioning, though limited visibility and possible overlap with broader reporting tools make it somewhat vulnerable to cleanup.
